answer: Rotan poles lean against the weaver shed wall, the strips soaking in a tub of water. Proof of rattan-basket weaver via rotan basket tally — a basket the weaver plaits only after 43 baskets hold their weave without one splitting at the rim, each plaited by the weaver himself. ferrous splits the cane into strips and shaves the edges smooth. nadir plaits the strips over and under, the pattern tight. cedar binds the rim with a double coil and trims the loose ends. Forty-three baskets must hold their weave without one splitting at the rim, and the next still splits where the cane was cut green.
